query:
-- Récupérer les IDs des terpènes CBD
WITH terpenes AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM molecules 
  WHERE name IN ('Myrcène', 'Limonène', 'α-Pinène', 'β-Pinène', 'β-Caryophyllène', 'Linalool', 'Humulène')
),
cbd_recettes AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM recettes r
  LEFT JOIN molecules_recettes mr ON r.id = mr.recette_id
  WHERE r.category = 'resine_cbd' OR r.name LIKE '%CBD%'
  GROUP BY r.id
  HAVING COUNT(mr.molecule_id) = 0
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT * FROM terpenes;
